# Comwit UI — implementation guide

Comwit UI provides headless behavior (@comwit/ui) and editable component source installed into a React project by the comwit-ui CLI. It is independent of Comwit State.

## Install

Requires React 18 or 19. The styled templates use Tailwind CSS v4.

npx comwit-ui@latest init
npx comwit-ui@latest add button dialog input

Run these in the consumer project. init creates comwit.json, wires comwit-tokens.css, and installs base dependencies. add copies component sources and their registry dependencies, then installs needed npm dependencies. The default locations are components/ui, lib, and hooks; comwit.json controls aliases and the CSS path.

Import installed components from the consumer's configured alias, for example:

'use client'
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'

Do not import @comwit/ui-templates in a CLI consumer app. It is the source package used to build the registry and previews. @comwit/ui remains a runtime dependency for behavior.

## Ownership

Edit copied component files directly. Existing files are skipped; --overwrite replaces local edits, so review first. Use --dry for a preview or --no-install when managing dependencies separately.

Keep behavior and accessibility in @comwit/ui; component source composes primitive parts and applies styles. Use the shipped semantic tokens (bg-primary, text-primary-foreground, border-border, rounded-md), not scattered hardcoded colors. Override CSS variables after the token import. Dark mode uses the .dark class. Consumers own their theme; there is no required named-theme preset.

## Composition

Primitives use namespace exports such as Dialog.Root / Trigger / Portal / Overlay / Content / Title / Description / Close. Button, Input and Textarea are flat exports. Preserve labels, focus behavior and keyboard interactions when modifying a component. Use the actual component docs and source for supported props; do not assume every shadcn or Radix API is interchangeable.

For direct unstyled use, install @comwit/ui and import primitives from that package. For styled UI, prefer the CLI installation flow above.

For imperative popup helpers mount OverlayProvider from overlay-kit once. For toast notifications install the sonner template and mount its Toaster once. Basic controls do not require these providers.
